description: Convert a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP or TIFF into one multi-size .ico (16 to 256 px), padding or cropping non-square images. AVIF, HEIC and SVG are not accepted here. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/png-to-ico (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The source image as base64. Send the whole file as it is, up to 50 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/png-to-ico (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

fit.description: How a non-square image becomes a square icon: pad keeps the whole picture and fills the sides with transparency; crop fills the square from the centre and cuts the long side. Square images are unaffected.

name.description: The source filename. The icon keeps its stem: logo.png becomes logo.ico.

sizes.description: Pixel sizes to pack into the one .ico file, from 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256. Defaults to 16, 32, 48 and 256, which covers browser tabs, the Windows taskbar and Explorer.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif (first frame), image/bmp or image/tiff. SVG, AVIF and HEIC are not accepted here.

name: png_to_ico
title: PNG to ICO Converter
